행동을 방해하는 것으로 정의와 반대

② consequence(결과)
행동 후의 결과를 의미하며 격려하는 자극과 다름

③ incentive(유인책, 동기) ←정답
사람이 무언가를 하거나 더 열심히 일하도록 격려하는 것 = incentive

④ regulation(규정)
규칙이나 법규를 의미하며 격려와 다른 맥락

questions.passage: However, such commercialization risks culturtainment becoming homogeneous and losing its original 'message' that could lead to a __________ (dilute) of audiences.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: dilute → dilution: 관사 a와 전치사 of 사이에 위치하여 명사가 필요. 'a dilution of audiences(관객의 희석)'라는 의미. 동사 dilute(희석하다)를 명사 dilution(희석)으로 변환.

questions.passage: The economic benefit of culturtainment makes it attractive to __________ (politics) and policy makers alike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: politics → politicians(정치인들): 명사를 사람 명사 복수형으로 변환
det.analysis: politics → politicians: to 뒤에 and policy makers와 병렬 구조로 사람을 나타내는 복수 명사가 필요. politics(정치)를 politician(정치인)의 복수형 politicians로 변환.

questions.passage: The economic benefit of culturtainment makes it attractive to politicians and policy makers alike. A potential increase in inbound visitor numbers coupled with their demand for related goods and services (travel, accommodation, retail) is an incentive for those within governments and authorities to work with cultural groups in order to develop celebrations and commemorations into larger and more high-profile events. However, such commercialization risks culturtainment becoming homogeneous and losing its original 'message' that could lead to a dilution of audiences. This could also lead to smaller non-commercial independent events being set up that would only serve to divide audiences further. This is something that planners and stakeholders will need to balance against __________. Changing political, social and religious landscapes will lead to the emergence of new cultures, and with them new culturtainment experiences. Overall this is a healthy growth sector of the entertainment industry, but one that by its very nature is delicate in the face of exploitation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① potential financial gain(잠재적 재정적 이득) ←정답
본문: 기획자와 이해관계자가 잠재적 재정적 이득과 균형을 맞출 필요가 있다

② cultural identity(문화적 정체성)
균형을 잡아야 할 대상이 경제적 맥락이므로 문화적 정체성은 부적절

③ audience growth(관객 성장)
관객의 희석/분열이 논의되고 있으나 빈칸의 직접 맥락과 불일치

④ political power(정치적 권력)
정치인이 언급되나 균형의 대상은 재정적 이득이지 권력 아님
det.tip: potential financial gain(잠재적 재정적 이득): balance against ~(~와 균형을 맞추다)

questions.passage: The economic benefit of culturtainment makes it attractive to politicians and policy makers alike. A potential increase in inbound visitor numbers coupled with their demand for related goods and services (travel, accommodation, retail) is an incentive for those within governments and authorities to __________ in order to develop celebrations and commemorations into larger and more high-profile events. However, such commercialization risks culturtainment becoming homogeneous and losing its original 'message' that could lead to a dilution of audiences. This could also lead to smaller non-commercial independent events being set up that would only serve to divide audiences further. This is something that planners and stakeholders will need to balance against potential financial gain. Changing political, social and religious landscapes will lead to the emergence of new cultures, and with them new culturtainment experiences. Overall this is a healthy growth sector of the entertainment industry, but one that by its very nature is delicate in the face of exploitation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: work with cultural groups(문화 단체와 협력하다)
det.analysis:
① compete with local businesses(지역 업체와 경쟁하다)
정부가 지역 업체와 경쟁한다는 것은 원문 맥락과 불일치

② work with cultural groups(문화 단체와 협력하다) ←정답
본문: 정부와 당국이 문화 단체와 협력하여 축제와 기념행사를 발전시킨다

③ restrict public gatherings(공공 모임을 제한하다)
제한은 발전/성장이라는 본문 흐름과 반대

④ regulate entertainment sectors(오락 분야를 규제하다)
규제보다는 협력이라는 맥락이 본문 흐름에 맞음
det.tip: work with(~와 협력하다): collaborate with, cooperate with와 유사
